description: List events from a Nextcloud calendar within an optional time range. Returns event details including time, location, attendees, recurrence, and UIDs.

calendarName.description: The calendar name. Use list_calendars to find available calendar names.

from.description: Start of time range (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-04-12 or 2026-04-12T09:00:00Z). Defaults to today.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default: 50)

to.description: End of time range (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-04-12 or 2026-04-12T09:00:00Z). Defaults to 30 days from now.

name: list_events
title: List Calendar Events
